hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: The visualization is cropped at the bottom — the circle pack overflows its container and is cut off mid-render — which is a hard layout failure; compounding this, the button palette (blue active, green regenerate, grey outline) feels inconsistent rather than designed, and the edge bundles render as heavy dark strokes that overwhelm the circle geometry rather than complementing it.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node radii, d3.pack handles circle area encoding natively, partition uses scaleSqrt for radial scale, all domains are data-driven via d3.extent/root.height, and key functions are present on node and link selections — minor gap is hierarchy links join missing a key function.
flags: Update Storm: easing-params sliders call updateLayout() on every input event, firing 1500ms flubber transitions at slider-drag frequency
Mid-Flight Snap: no .interrupt() call on nodeSelection before new transitions begin; on('interrupt') callback does not finalize current_x/current_y, leaving stale positional state for next layout
Mid-Flight Snap: force layout triggers a new flubber attrTween without interrupting any in-flight shape transition from a prior layout change
Mouse-Touch Fight: drag handlers on force simulation have no touch/mouse event filtering; mouseover/click listeners have no preventDefault or sourceEvent checks, risking double-trigger on mobile
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Three interaction traps present — un-throttled updateLayout calls on slider input (Update Storm), absent .interrupt() before transitions (Mid-Flight Snap), and no touch event filtering on drag and hover handlers (Mouse-Touch Fight) — with no infinite-loop or stale-closure issues found.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy reads cleanly in isolation, but edge bundles overlaid on 200 packed nodes produce an unreadable tangle in the lower quadrant; 10 Tableau colors, 1500ms flubber morphing across 7 layout modes, and simultaneous controls (tension slider, link toggles, regenerate) compound the load beyond what a single view can manage.
